# World-Specific Crash and Freeze Affecting PC and Quest Users — Prop Hunt by Mmmelon

**World:** Prop Hunt by Mmmaellon  

**World last updated (reported):** April 7, 2025  

**Issue type:** World stability / compatibility / possible Udon or resource issue

### Summary

I am reporting a recurring issue in the VRChat world **Prop Hunt by Mmmelon**. The world appears to cause all players in an instance to freeze simultaneously before VRChat crashes. This affects both PC and Quest users, although PC users appear to experience more severe crashes.

The issue occurs even when players are not actively playing a round and are simply standing idle.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Join Prop Hunt by Mmmelon.

2. Remain in the world, even without starting or playing a round.

3. After approximately 30–40 minutes, all players in the instance freeze at roughly the same time.

4. Loud audio can still be heard while the world is frozen.

5. VRChat crashes.

6. Rejoin the same world.

7. After the world finishes loading, VRChat crashes again approximately 38 seconds later.

### Expected result

Players should be able to remain in the world without experiencing freezes or crashes, regardless of whether they are actively playing.

### Actual result

All players appear to freeze simultaneously, followed by VRChat crashing. Rejoining results in another crash approximately 38 seconds after loading into the world.

### Additional information

- The issue happens regardless of whether a game round is active.

- It affects multiple players simultaneously.

- It affects both PC and Quest users.

- PC users appear to be affected more severely.

- The issue has been reproduced in multiple instances.

- The world has reportedly not been updated since April 7, 2025, before numerous subsequent VRChat updates.

- The issue may be related to an outdated world component, Udon behaviour, resource accumulation, or compatibility with newer VRChat versions. The exact cause is currently unknown.

### Request

Could the VRChat team investigate whether this world is experiencing a compatibility or stability issue with newer VRChat client versions?

I would also appreciate guidance on whether this should be investigated by VRChat or referred directly to the world creator as it triggers anti cheat and then crash
title: Prop Hunt by Mmmelon Causes Mass Freezes and Crashes on PC and Quest
